domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
k is an integer and 1 <= k <= n
floor is the greatest integer less than or equal to its real input
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n > 1 and every real number t: if for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, the floor of k times t equals k minus 1, then E_n of t equals H_n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n greater than 1
if for all integers k with 1 less than or equal to k and k less than or equal to n, floor(k times t) equals k minus 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer parameter; appears in the range of k and as the index of E_n and H_n

variables.name: t
variables.role: real parameter in the floor condition; input to E_n(t)

variables.name: k
variables.role: quantified index in the premise; ranges from 1 to n

witness_dependencies: No existential witnesses are introduced; all quantified variables are universal
The value of E_n(t) is determined by n and t, and H_n is determined by n

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t, if floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, then E_n(t) = H_n - 1.
